blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A mother flying fox gently fans her wings to keep her young pup comfortable before wrapping it in a protective embrace as the little bat suckles milk beneath her wing. This intimate moment of maternal care was among the wildlife behaviors documented by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Soccsksargen during a monitoring activity in Kulaman Valley, Arakan, Cotabato, from Oct. 24 to 26. The three-day monitoring also revealed a thriving colony of approximately 30,000 endangered large flying foxes (Pteropus vampyrus) roosting across 39 trees, highlighting the valley’s importance as a habitat for the threatened species.
